gloss: the press corps; reporters on the scene

definitions.gloss: the press corps; the assembled reporters and camera crews
definitions.explanation: The body of journalists, photographers, and camera crews gathered to cover an event. Treated as a single collective group, so it is used with verbs like {囲|かこ}む (surround) and {詰|つ}めかける (throng).

examples.japanese: {報道陣|ほうどうじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}めかけた→詰めかける：14192_tsumekakeru⟧。
examples.english: The press corps thronged the place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{報道陣|ほうどうじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれて→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: Surrounded by reporters, the athlete answered questions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{報道陣|ほうどうじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まっていた→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: A large press corps had gathered at the accident site from early morning.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧ (news reporting) plus the suffix 〜⟦{陣|じん}→陣：30535_jin⟧, which turns a field of activity into the body of people staffing it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {報道陣|ほうどうじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれる→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to be surrounded by reporters
- {報道陣|ほうどうじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}めかける→詰めかける：14192_tsumekakeru⟧: the press throngs a place
- {報道陣|ほうどうじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in front of the assembled press
- {報道陣|ほうどうじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to open (something) to the press

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦マスコミ→マスコミ：03872_masukomi⟧: the mass media — the industry and its outlets, not the reporters physically present
- ⟦{記者団|きしゃだん}→記者団：30557_kishadan⟧: the group of reporters — narrower, writers only, common in political coverage
